content.blurb: Registry resolution, fallback, nested updates, and bounded rows share one caller-defined order.

body.react: <SchemaForm controls={ { bespoke: bespokeControl } } initialValues={ { berthCode: 'D-14', arrivalWindow: '04:00–06:00', cargoShape: { kind: 'bulk' }, agent: { name: 'North Harbor Agency', sibling: 'preserved' }, charges: [{ description: 'Pilotage' }] } } onSubmit={ validSubmit } strings={ ENGLISH_STRINGS } view={ CONTROLS_VIEW } />
body.rationale: The rendered form is generated from a caller-supplied schema containing ordered sections, a custom registry renderer, an unknown-hint fallback, an unavailable structured value, a nested group, and a bounded collection. The closed descriptor vocabulary cannot declare that schema or its dynamic collection behavior without silently approximating it.

content.blurb: Visibility, required, read-only, computed, and presentation outcomes project before save.

body.react: <SchemaForm initialValues={ { contact: '', reference: 'REQ-2048', total: 0, status: 'Awaiting review', internalNote: 'Retained in the submitted candidate' } } onSubmit={ validSubmit } ruleGraph={ RULE_GRAPH } strings={ ENGLISH_STRINGS } view={ RULES_VIEW } />
body.rationale: The rendered form depends on a rule-graph evaluation that simultaneously changes visibility, required and read-only states, resolves a computed currency value, adds presentation metadata, and blocks saving while pending. Those schema and rule outcomes cannot be represented by the closed descriptor controls.

content.blurb: Save to inspect inline association, summary partitioning, and summary focus.

body.react: <SchemaForm initialValues={ { name: '', email: 'ops@example.test' } } onSubmit={ validationSubmit } strings={ ENGLISH_STRINGS } view={ VALIDATION_VIEW } />
body.rationale: The scenario requires schema-driven inline error association, partitioning deeper and root JSON-pointer errors into a focusable summary, and moving focus after submission. The closed vocabulary has no form-schema, validation-error, error-summary, or focus descriptor.

content.blurb: Pseudo-expanded and Arabic copy exercise locale formatting, logical direction, and shared theme tokens.

body.react: <><SchemaForm initialValues={ { replacementCost: 1234567.89, completion: 62.5, inspectionDate: '2026-08-13' } } localeChain={ ['en-XA'] } onSubmit={ validSubmit } strings={ PSEUDO_STRINGS } view={ PSEUDO_VIEW } /><SchemaForm initialValues={ { amount: 1234567.89, date: '2026-08-13' } } localeChain={ ['ar'] } onSubmit={ validSubmit } strings={ ARABIC_STRINGS } view={ ARABIC_VIEW } /></>
body.blazor: <HarborlineSchemaForm InitialValues="PseudoValues" LocaleChain="PseudoLocale" OnSubmit="ValidSubmit" Strings="PseudoStrings" View="PseudoView" /><HarborlineSchemaForm InitialValues="ArabicValues" LocaleChain="ArabicLocale" OnSubmit="ValidSubmit" Strings="ArabicStrings" View="ArabicView" />
body.rationale: One dark gallery scene renders two independent schema forms: an en-XA form with currency, percentage, and date formatting and an Arabic form with RTL-localized currency and date formatting. A single closed environment cannot encode both nested locale contexts, and the descriptor vocabulary cannot express the schema controls or locale-aware formatters.

content.blurb: Hostile form content carries a label longer than its control, a grouped large number, escaped angle brackets and an ampersand, and a name with diacritics and an em dash.

body.react: <SchemaForm initialValues={{ longLabel: 'Certified', largeNumber: '1,284,905', escapedText: 'Bay 4 <grid C-7> & 8', surveyor: 'Ordnance Survey — Niño Ångström' }} onSubmit={validSubmit} strings={ENGLISH_STRINGS} view={CONTENT_VIEW} />
body.rationale: The schema-driven field labels and caller values require form controls and field semantics that the closed control vocabulary cannot express.

body.rationale: The closed control vocabulary has no schema-form control and cannot express an empty form view or the component's localized empty string in both projection lanes.
